traditions.name: Sambalpuri Bandha
traditions.technique_evidence: Yarn tie-dye (Bandha/ikat); specimen cotton warp and weft.
traditions.next_research: Individual maker and piece-level provenance absent.

traditions.name: Bomkai
traditions.production_geography: Sonepur and Boudh are department-listed production centres.
traditions.technique_evidence: Woven threadwork; cotton warp/weft in specimen. Detailed construction still pending.
traditions.next_research: Origin-village chronology and supplementary-weft technical evidence still pending.

traditions.name: Khandua
traditions.production_geography: Nuapatna / Cuttack; eastern clusters in seller description.
traditions.technique_evidence: Ikat silk with temple borders; specimen lists Malda silk in warp and weft.
traditions.next_research: Do not infer silk was grown in Odisha or that this commercial piece is temple cloth.

traditions.name: Kotpad
traditions.technique_evidence: Saved institutional evidence associates Mirgan weavers with aul-root dyes.
traditions.next_research: Named maker, current product and detailed dye process remain pending.

traditions.name: Habaspuri
traditions.technique_evidence: Technique remains unverified in this checkpoint.
traditions.next_research: Homepage mention is not a product listing; current makers and construction pending.

traditions.name: Berhampuri Patta
traditions.technique_evidence: Department identifies silk saree/joda; construction remains pending.
traditions.next_research: Border construction and named current maker still pending.
